Rashi on Niddah 42a:11:1.hebrew: לעולם לא שמיע ליה מתני' - ודקאמרינן: מסברא נוגעת הויא — לא היא, מסברא לא מיפשט לן, דאיכא למימר: מדאחמיר רחמנא בבעלי קריין בסיני, דכתיב (שמות י״ט: ט״ו) אל תגשו אל אשה, ולא הזהיר על טמא שרץ — רואה הויא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:11:1.english: Actually, he did not hear the Mishnah - And that which we said, "By logic she is [considered] one who touches [semen]" — that is not so; by logic it is not resolved for us, for it can be said: Since the Merciful One was stringent regarding those who experienced a seminal emission at Sinai, as it is written (Exodus 19:15): "Do not come near a woman," and He did not warn against one defiled by a creeping creature, she is [considered] one who experiences a discharge.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:13:1.hebrew: כולכו ברוקא חדא תפיתו - כולכם שמעתם שמועה אחת. תפיתו לשון רוק, וחבירו בכתובות: תוף שדי, בפרק אף על פי (כתובות דף סא:):
Rashi on Niddah 42a:13:1.english: All of you spit with one saliva - All of you heard one tradition. "Tafitu" is an expression of spitting, and its counterpart in Ketubot is "spit and cast out" [tuf shedi], in the chapter "Af Al Pi" (Ketubot 61b).

Rashi on Niddah 42a:14:1.english: He said to him - "Abaye said well to you" [i.e., what Abaye told you was correct].

Rashi on Niddah 42a:14:2.hebrew: אבל לסתור ולטמא במשהו רואה הויא - דאי נמי דיה כבועלה, מטמיא כבועלה במשהו, וסתרה כבועלה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:14:2.english: But to negate and to become impure with any amount, she is one who experienced an emission - For even if [we say] "it is sufficient for her to be like the one who had intercourse with her," she becomes impure like the one who had intercourse with her with any amount, and negates [her count] like the one who had intercourse with her.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:15:1.hebrew: הזבה ושומרת יום - הכי קאמר: בין שראתה ג' ימים, בין שראתה יום אחד, מטמאה בבית החיצון בראייה ראשונה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:15:1.english: A zava and a woman who observes a day - This is what [the baraita] is saying: Whether she experienced a discharge for three days or whether she experienced a discharge for one day, she becomes impure in the outer chamber upon the first sighting.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:15:2.english: And a woman after childbirth - [The Gemara] explains [this] later.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:15:3.hebrew: כולן מטמאין בפנים כבחוץ - בראייה ראשונה, אבל בשניה ליכא למימר, דהא בלא ראייה טמאה היא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:15:3.english: All of them become impure inside as outside - [This applies] to the first sighting; but regarding the second [sighting], it cannot be said [that she becomes impure], for even without [this] sighting, she is [already] impure.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:16:1.hebrew: אי בימי נדה - ילדה וראתה, הא תני ליה, ואי בימי זיבה, הא תני ליה לזיבה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:16:1.english: If in the days of menstruation - [If she] gave birth and saw [blood], he has already taught it; and if in the days of ziva, he has already taught it regarding ziva.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:17:1.hebrew: מטומאה לטהרה - לאחר שבועים, וקיימא לן כבית הלל דאמרי בבנות כותים (לעיל נדה דף לה:): ביומי וטבילה תלא רחמנא, דלא הוי דם טוהר אלא לאחר טבילה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:17:1.english: From impurity to purity - After two weeks [of impurity], and we hold in accordance with Beit Hillel, who say in [the chapter] Benot Kutim (above, Niddah 35b): The Merciful One made [it] dependent on [both] days and immersion, so that it is not blood of purity until after immersion.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:18:1.hebrew: ונעקר דם - לבית החיצון, ועמד שם יום או יומים:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:18:1.english: And blood was uprooted - Into the outer chamber, and it remained there a day or two.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:18:2.hebrew: טמאה - כל זמן שהוא בה, וכשיצא בעיא טבילה אחריתי, דלא טהרתה טבילה. והיינו דתניא: יולדת מטמיא בבית החיצון:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:18:2.english: She is impure - As long as it is inside her; and when it exits, she requires another immersion, as the [first] immersion did not purify her. And this is what was taught [in the baraita]: "A woman after childbirth becomes impure in the outer chamber."

Rashi on Niddah 42a:19:1.hebrew: טומאה בלועה היא - וקיימא לן בפרק בהמה המקשה (חולין דף עא.): טומאה בלועה אינה מטמאה, לא במגע ולא במשא. והכא, הא טומאה בלועה היא! ולא דמיא לכל הנשים שמטמאות בבית החיצון — דהתם משום ראייה דמאתמול היא וטומאת שבעה, ורחמנא אמר "בבשרה", מכי אתא בבית החיצון הויא ראייה. אבל הכא, משום משא ונגיעה היא וטומאת ערב; דאי משום ראייה — מאתמול איעקר ומאתמול הויא ראייה, וראייה דמאתמול לא מהניא לה האידנא, דמאתמול הוה להו ימי טומאה והשתא הוו להו ימי טוהר, וטומאה בלועה לא מטמיא במגע ובמשא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:19:1.english: It is encapsulated impurity - And it is established for us in the chapter "Behemah HaMaksheh" (Chullin 71a) that encapsulated impurity does not impart impurity, neither through contact nor through carrying. And here, this is indeed encapsulated impurity! Nor is it comparable to all [other] women, who become impure in the outer chamber — for there, [the impurity] is due to yesterday's discharge and [imposes] a seven-day impurity, and the Merciful One said: "[in] her flesh" — from the moment it arrives in the outer chamber it is [considered] a discharge. But here, [her impurity] is on account of carrying and contact, and [an impurity until] evening; for if [she were impure] because of a discharge — it was uprooted yesterday, and yesterday was [when] the discharge [took place], and yesterday's discharge does not affect her now, since yesterday was her days of impurity and now is her days of purity; and encapsulated impurity does not impart impurity through contact or carrying.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:19:2.english: I explained to him - I explained the reason to him.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:19:3.english: And he nodded his head to me - He agreed with my words and nodded his head.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:1:1.hebrew: וכי תימא חיישי' שמא נשתייר בה - ומספיקא קא מטמאה, א"כ מאי אי אפשר? חיישינן מיבעי ליה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:1:1.english: And if you would say we are concerned lest [semen] remained in her - And out of doubt she is rendered impure; if so, what is [the meaning of] "It is impossible"? He should have [said], "We are concerned."

Rashi on Niddah 42a:20:1.hebrew: בגדים בבית הבליעה - בגדים שהוא לבוש בהן בשעה שנוגע בה אינן טמאין, שאין להן טומאת מגע, דאמר רחמנא: לא יאכל לטמאה בה (ויקרא כ״ב:ח׳) - אין לך אלא מה שאמור בה: אכילה, ולא מגע. ומה היא מטמאה? בגדים שהוא לבוש בשעת בליעה, כדכתיב (שם יז): [וכל] נפש אשר תאכל נבלה וטריפה באזרח ובגר וכבס בגדיו וטהר. ובנבלת עוף טהור כתיב, דנבלת בהמה לא מטמאה בבית הבליעה, כדאמר בשמעתין, ונבלת עוף טמא נמי לא מטמאה, כדאמר בתורת כהנים: מי שאיסורו משום בל תאכל נבלה - יצא עוף טמא, שאין איסורו משום בל תאכל נבלה, אלא משום בל תאכל טמא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:20:1.english: Garments in the throat - Garments that one is wearing at the time that he touches it [the carcass of a kosher bird] are not impure, as they have no impurity through contact, for the Merciful One states: "[An unslaughtered carcass or torn flesh] he shall not eat, to become defiled by it" (Leviticus 22:8) — you have [defilement] only in that which is stated regarding it: eating, and not contact. And what does it defile? Garments that one is wearing at the time of swallowing, as it is written (ibid. 17:15): "[And every] person who eats an unslaughtered carcass or torn flesh, among the native-born or the stranger, he shall wash his clothes and be pure." And [this verse] is written regarding the carcass of a kosher bird, for the carcass of an animal does not impart impurity in the throat, as [the Gemara] states in our sugya; and the carcass of an unclean bird also does not impart impurity, as it states in Torat Kohanim: "[A species] whose prohibition is on account of 'Do not eat an unslaughtered carcass' — this excludes an unclean bird, whose prohibition is not on account of 'Do not eat an unslaughtered carcass,' but rather on account of 'Do not eat an unclean [bird].'"

Rashi on Niddah 42a:2:1.hebrew: אלא לרבא נמי - דלא אזלה, הילכך כל שעה פלטה. והא דר' שמעון דיכולה לטבול לשמושה, כגון שלא נתהפכה לאחר הטבילה, ודרבא במתהפכת:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:2:1.english: Rather, according to Rava too - That she did not walk; therefore, she continually discharges [semen]. And that [ruling] of Rabbi Shimon, that she can immerse for her intercourse, is [a case] such as where she did not turn over after the immersion; and that of Rava is where she turns over.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:3:1.hebrew: ורבא - לפרושי לן קרא אתא: דכי כתיב ורחצו במים, דמשמע דיכולה לטבול בו ביום, כשאינה מתהפכת. ל"א: מתהפכת בשעת תשמיש, ואין הזרע נקלט ברחם יחד, הילכך פולטת והולכת מעט מעט; אינה מתהפכת בשעת תשמיש, נקלט הזרע יחד, ויוצא בבת אחת:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:3:1.english: And Rava - [He] came to explain the verse to us: that when it is written, "And they shall bathe in water," which implies that she can immerse on that [same] day [and become pure in the evening, this is] when she does not turn over. Another explanation: [She] turns over during intercourse, and the semen is not retained in the womb all together; therefore, she continually discharges [it] little by little. [If] she does not turn over during intercourse, the semen is retained all together and emerges all at once.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:4:1.hebrew: רואה הויא - משום ראייה טמייה קרא, ומשום נוגעת בשכבת זרע? דעד השתא הויא נגיעת בית הסתרים, ולא הויא טמאה אלא ביום תשמיש ומגזרת הכתוב, וכי פלטה, נגעה לבראי ומטמיא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:4:1.english: Is she one who experiences an emission - Did Scripture render her impure on account of an emission, or on account of touching semen? For until now, it was contact in a concealed part of the body, and she was not impure except on the day of intercourse and by scriptural decree, and when she discharges [it], it touches the exterior and renders [her] impure.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:5:1.hebrew: לסתור - בזיבה בימי ספירה: אי רואה הויא סותרת, אבל נוגעת לא, שאם נגעה בשום טומאה אינה סותרת, דהא "וספרה לה" כתיב. והאיכא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:5:1.english: To negate - In [a case of] ziva during the days of counting: If she is [considered] one who experienced an emission, she negates [her count], but [if she is considered] one who came into contact, no, as if she touched any impurity, she does not negate [her count], for behold, it is written: "And she shall count for herself" (Leviticus 15:28). And isn't there...?

Rashi on Niddah 42a:5:2.hebrew: ולטמא במשהו - לראייה לא בעינן שיעורא, כדאמרי' במתני': לדם נדה ולזיבה ולקרי מטמאין בכל שהוא. אבל נוגע בעי שיעורא, כדאמר בפירקין (לקמן נדה דף מג:): איכא למ"ד בכעדשה, ואיכא למ"ד כחתימת פי האמה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:5:2.english: And to impart impurity with any amount - For an emission, we do not require a [minimum] measure, as we say in the mishna: [With regard to] blood of a niddah, and [blood of] zivah, and semen, they impart impurity in any amount. However, one who touches [semen] requires a [minimum] measure, as [the Gemara] says in our chapter (below, Niddah 43b): there is one who says [it requires] a lentil-bulk, and there is one who says like the sealing of the orifice of the penis.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:6:1.english: If he had heard - [This refers] to Rav Shmuel.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:6:2.hebrew: מתניתא - דפליגי רבנן ור"ש לעיל, דקאמרי רבנן: פולטת שכבת זרע מטמא בפנים כבחוץ, ולר"ש: דדיה כבועלה:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:6:2.english: The baraita - In which the Rabbis and Rabbi Shimon disagree above, where the Rabbis say: "A woman who discharges semen becomes impure inside [the body] as outside," and according to Rabbi Shimon: "It is sufficient for her to be like the man who had intercourse with her."

Rashi on Niddah 42a:6:3.hebrew: לרבנן רואה הויא - לענין לטמא בפנים כבחוץ, ולר"ש נוגעת הויא:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:6:3.english: According to the Rabbis, she is one who sees - With regard to rendering [her] impure inside as outside; and according to Rabbi Shimon, she is one who touches.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:7:1.hebrew: ואי לא שמיע ליה - אמאי מספקא ליה? מסברא נוגעת הויא, דהא לא מגופה חזיא, אלא מה שקבלה היא פולטת:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:7:1.english: And if he did not hear [it] - Why was he in doubt? Based on reason, she is [considered] one who touches [semen], for she did not experience a discharge from her own body; rather, she is [merely] emitting what she received.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:8:1.hebrew: ואליבא דרבנן לא קמיבעיא ליה - דכיון דלרבנן מטמיא בפנים כבחוץ, אלמא רואה הויא, וכ"ש דמטמאה במשהו. ולענין סתירה נמי סתרה, דהא בתורת זיבה מרבי ליה מיהיה זובו:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:8:1.english: And according to the Rabbis, he did not raise the dilemma - For since, according to the Rabbis, she becomes impure inside [the body] as outside, evidently she is [considered] one who experiences an emission, and all the more so does she become impure with any amount. And regarding negation [of clean days] as well, she negates [her count], for [Scripture] includes it under the law of ziva from "shall be [her] flow" (Leviticus 15:19).

Rashi on Niddah 42a:8:2.english: When he raises the dilemma, [it is] according to Rabbi Shimon, and with regard to imparting impurity inside, he does not raise the dilemma - For we have heard Rabbi Shimon [say] that it does not impart impurity.

Rashi on Niddah 42a:9:1.hebrew: כי קא מבעיא ליה לסתור ולטמא במשהו - מהו? מי אמרי': כי אמר ר' שמעון דיה כבועלה לטמא בפנים כבחוץ, מה בועלה לא מטמא, איהי נמי לא מטמאה; אבל לסתור ולטמא במשהו, לא משוי לה כנוגעת, דהא א"נ אמר דיה כבועלה, סתרה ומטמאה במשהו כבועלה; או דילמא לא שנא, דכי היכי דלענין טומאת פנים משוי לה נוגעת, לענין משהו וסתירה נמי משוי לה נוגעת:
Rashi on Niddah 42a:9:1.english: When he raises the dilemma, [it is] to negate and to render impure in any amount - What is [the dilemma]? Do we say: When Rabbi Shimon said, "It is sufficient for her to be like her partner," [this applied only] to rendering impure inside as outside—just as her partner does not become impure [while it is inside], she too does not become impure; but with regard to negating [the count of clean days] and rendering impure in any amount, he does not treat her as one who touches [an impurity], for even if he said, "It is sufficient for her to be like her partner," she negates [her count] and becomes impure in any amount like her partner [who experienced an emission]; or perhaps it is no different: just as with regard to internal impurity he treats her as one who touches [an impurity], with regard to [requiring] a minimum amount and negating [the count] he also treats her as one who touches [an impurity]?

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:11:1.hebrew: מדאחמיר רחמנא אבעלי קריין בסיני - מאיש לא מוכח, דפשיטא דרואה הוי; אלא מאשה, דמשום פולטת הזהיר רחמנא ג' ימים, אל תגשו אל אשה:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:11:1.english: Since the Merciful One was stringent with regard to those who experienced a seminal emission at Sinai - From a man [this] cannot be proven, for it is obvious that he is one who experiences an emission (ro'eh); rather, [it is proven] from a woman, for on account of [a woman] discharging [semen] (poletet), the Merciful One warned [them for] three days: "Do not come near a woman" (Exodus 19:15).

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:12:1.hebrew: דהא זבין ומצורעים דחמירי - אף ע"ג דאכתי לא נאמרה פרשת טומאה ושילוח טמאים, מ"מ ראוי להחמיר בהן יותר מבפולטת:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:12:1.english: For behold, zavin and lepers are more stringent - Even though the section of ritual impurity and the sending away of the impure had not yet been stated, nevertheless, it would have been appropriate to be more stringent with them than with a woman who discharges [semen].

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:14:1.hebrew: עד כאן לא קאמר ר' שמעון כו' - אבל לטמא במשהו, רואה הויא. וא"ת: והא אמר בפסחים פרק אלו דברים (פסחים דף סז:), דר' שמעון סבר כר' נתן, דזב בעי שיעור כחתימת פי האמה, ויליף בעל קרי מזב; וא"כ, אמאי מטמא במשהו? נימא: דיה כבועלה! וי"ל: דרבי שמעון ודאי לא מטמא במשהו; והכא ה"ק: אפי' למאן דאית ליה כר' שמעון דפולטת ולא מטמאה בפנים כבחוץ, מ"מ מטמאה במשהו, אי סבר דאיש מטמא במשהו:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:14:1.english: Rabbi Shimon said only, etc. - But regarding rendering [her] impure with any amount (mashehu), she is [treated as] one who experiences an emission (ro'ah). And if you say: But didn't [the Gemara] say in Pesachim, chapter "Elu Devarim" (Pesachim 67b), that Rabbi Shimon holds in accordance with Rabbi Natan, that a zav requires a measure [of discharge] equal to the sealing of the opening of the penis (ke-chatimat pi ha-amah), and he derives [the law of] one who experienced a seminal emission (ba'al keri) from a zav; and if so, why is [she] rendered impure with any amount? Let us say: "It is sufficient for her to be like the one who had intercourse with her" (dayah ke-vo'alah)! And one can say: Rabbi Shimon certainly does not render [her] impure with any amount. And here, this is what [the Gemara] is saying: Even according to the one who holds in accordance with Rabbi Shimon regarding a woman who discharges [semen], that she does not become impure on the inside as on the outside, nevertheless, she becomes impure with any amount if he holds that a man becomes impure with any amount.

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:18:1.hebrew: בירידה טמאה - הדם טמא, דביומי וטבילה תליא רחמנא; וטמאה האשה משום נוגע, טומאת ערב:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:18:1.english: On [her] descent, she is impure - The blood is impure, for the Merciful One made [its purity] dependent on [both the] days and immersion; and the woman is impure on account of contact [with it], [contracting] impurity until evening.

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:19:1.hebrew: אמאי טומאה בלועה היא - לאביי, דאמר בסמוך אותו מקום של אשה בלוע הוי, ניחא דקרי ליה טומאה בלועה. ולרבא נמי, דאמר בית הסתרים הוי, י"ל דמיירי בשנעקר הדם מן המקור ולא יצא לבית החיצון. והא דמסיק שיצא לחוץ, לרבא לא צריך שיצא לחוץ לגמרי, אלא שיצא לבית החיצון, דהוי בית הסתרים וטמא במשא. ומיהו, עשאוה כנבלת עוף טהור משמע דסבר כאביי, דלרבא אמר לקמן דמקום נבלת עוף טהור בית הסתרים הוי:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:19:1.english: Why? It is encapsulated impurity - According to Abaye, who says nearby that that place in a woman [i.e., the vagina] is [considered] encapsulated, it is well understood that he calls it "encapsulated impurity." And according to Rava as well, who says that it is a concealed part [of the body] (beit hasetarim), it can be said that [the Gemara] is dealing with [a case where] the blood was uprooted from the source [the uterus] and did not emerge into the outer chamber [the vagina]. And that which [the Gemara] concludes, [that this applies] "when it emerged outside," according to Rava it does not need to have emerged outside completely, but rather that it emerged into the outer chamber, which is a concealed part [of the body], and [she is thus] impure through carrying. However, [the explanation that] "they rendered it like the carcass of a kosher bird" implies that [Rabbi Avin] holds in accordance with Abaye, for according to Rava, he says below that the place of the carcass of a kosher bird is a concealed part [of the body].

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:20:1.hebrew: עשאוה כנבלת עוף טהור - אע"ג דבעלמא לא החמירו בטומאה בלועה, הכא גזרו רבנן טפי, כדי שלא יבא לטעות ולטהרו על ידי טבילה אפילו כשיצא לחוץ; וכי משני הכא נמי כשיצא לחוץ, סבר דלא גזרו:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:20:1.english: They made it like the carcass of a kosher bird - Even though generally they were not stringent regarding encapsulated impurity (tum'ah belu'ah), here the Rabbis decreed further, so that one should not come to err and purify [it] through immersion even when it emerged outside; and when [the Gemara] answers, "Here too, when it emerged outside," it maintains that they did not decree.

Tosafot on Niddah 42a:7:1.hebrew: מסתברא דנוגע הויא - ומסיני לא גמרינן, דחדוש הוא. ולהכי לרבנן נמי איצטריך יהיה, דלא גמרינן מסיני, אע"ג דבסמוך בעי למימר דאף לר"ש רואה הויא וסתרה:
Tosafot on Niddah 42a:7:1.english: It stands to reason that she is [considered] one who came into contact [with semen] - And we do not derive [her status] from Sinai, as it was a novelty (chidush). And for this reason, according to the Rabbis as well, [the verse] "shall be" (yehiyeh) was necessary, because we do not derive [it] from Sinai, even though nearby [the Gemara] seeks to say that even according to Rabbi Shimon she is [considered] one who experienced an emission (ro'ah) and negates [her count of clean days].
